_comment: Morena-mini 0.5B student: 16L x 1536d, GQA 12/4 (head_dim 128, same as the teacher), SwiGLU 4096, tied 64k embeddings, RoPE 5e5, seq 4096 -> 0.503B params (0.403B non-embedding). Pruned one-shot out of morena1p5b-mid step_00075083 by prune_mini.py, then distilled with CE + KL(teacher||student) by train_distill.py. GLOBAL BATCH = 256 seqs x 4096 = 1.05M tokens/step, node-count invariant. 32 GPUs, micro_batch 2 -> grad_accum 4 (exact). 10,000 steps = 10.5B tokens. LR 3e-4 (Moonlight-scaled Muon + AdamW), warmup 200, WSD decay over the last 1,000 steps. act_ckpt on because the distillation loss holds a second full-vocab logit tensor.
